name: Quill
tagline: Letters, resumes, reports, proposals and more, written from your ask and laid out in pages, as PDF, Word, Pages, HTML or Markdown.

illustrations.alt: A report laid out in pages, shown three ways: two pages of the PDF, the Word file and the Pages file, each with its file name.
illustrations.caption: One draft, every file: the PDF with page numbers and running heads, a Word file with real styles, and a Pages file saved by Pages.
